newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Apr regrade trades at -40cts.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Apr regrade trades at -40cts.

text.p: Singapore jet fuel/gas oil spread or regrade traded down late afternoon on Monday due to growing concerns of slowing demand for physical jet, traders said.
"The market is weakening because people feel that there is not much demand in the second quarter," one trader said.
April regrade was last quoted at -60/-30 cents compared to Thursday's -35/-20 cents, brokers said.
They said April traded earlier in the day at -40 cents.
Traders said the weakening regrade was also partly due to the strong gas oil market relative to jet fuel.
Gas oil dipped slightly relative to Thursday in quiet trading as most players preferred to stay on the sidelines as the West is closed for the Easter holiday.
April gas oil was last quoted at $25.75/$25.85 per barrel, down from Thursday's $25.85/$26.00, brokers said.
They said the market traded earlier in the day at $25.825 while May traded at $25.00.
May gas oil was last quoted at $24.80/$24.90, down 20 cents from Thursday.

Traders said lower gas oil prices were partly due to fears that after today, Singapore trader Hin Leong might stop its month-long support of the gas oil market which led to a more than $3.00 per barrel hike since early March.
Prices were boosted by Hin Leong's purchase of about 6.2 million barrels in March.
Fuel oil swaps were quoted down 50 cents in quiet trade with April at $98.50/$99.50. -- Singapore newsroom (+65-870-3093)
